Set data —————————————————————-

myData<- read.csv("C:/Users/rodrigum/Desktop/Paper2/database/soilresults.csv") 

myData$Site.number<-as.factor(myData$Site.number) #1
myData$State<-as.factor(myData$State)#2
myData$Grass.type<-as.factor(myData$Grass.type) #3
myData$ID<-as.factor(myData$ID) #4
myData$Sites<-as.factor(myData$Sites)#5
myData$PD.disturbance<-as.factor(myData$PD.disturbance) #6
myData$B.or.NB<-as.factor(myData$B.or.NB) #7
myData$Season<-as.factor(myData$Season) #8
myData$GROUPED<-as.factor(myData$GROUPED) #9
myData$Subcondition<-as.factor(myData$Subcondition) #10

myData$Bag.number<-as.factor(myData$Bag.number) #14
myData$Weight<-as.factor(myData$Weight) #15

myData<-myData[-c(22)] #TO REMOVE PD. NOT. ACCURATE

Scaling —————————————————————–

#separate data frame to scale numerical variables
myData_select<-myData %>% select(27:37)
myData_select<-scale(myData_select)
myData_select<-as.data.frame(myData_select,header=TRUE, row.names=1)

#join dataframes
myData<- myData[,-c(27:37)] 
myData<-cbind(myData,myData_select)

Bayesian models specifications ———————————————————

# Define options for the NUTS sampler
nchains <- 4    # number of chains (at least 4 for NUTS sampling)
niter <- 10000   # number of iterations per chain
nwarm <- 5000   # number of iterations to warm up before sampling 
#4 x (10000-5000)= 20000 iterations

Burrow models dry season ——————————————————————

ph

#ph
fitGLMM1_burrow <- brm(pHlog ~ + B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM1_burrow)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: pHlog ~ +B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 43) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     0.91      0.32     0.45     1.71 1.00     5956     9967
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                          0.37      0.68    -0.99     1.69 1.00
## B.or.NBNB                         -0.39      0.48    -1.33     0.58 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                    -0.41      0.97    -2.28     1.54 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous              -0.38      0.96    -2.25     1.57 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                -0.95      0.97    -2.85     0.99 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid           1.36      0.68     0.02     2.69 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous     0.38      0.66    -0.92     1.69 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain       0.37      0.66    -0.95     1.68 1.00
##                                Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                          9535    10364
## B.or.NBNB                         10571    11345
## Grass.typeArid                    10167    10274
## Grass.typeCalcareous              10014    10507
## Grass.typeMountain                 9926    10384
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          12207    12683
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous    12075    12693
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain      12027    12147
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.67      0.10     0.51     0.91 1.00     8965    10188
## 
## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).

# pHlog1_D2

pHlog1_D2_1<-fitGLMM1_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Grass.type, y = .value, fill=B.or.NB)) + labs( y = "pH scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="right")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
pHlog1_D2_1

pHlog1_D2_3<-fitGLMM1_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Grass.type, y = .value, fill=B.or.NB)) + labs( y = "pH scaled" )+
  stat_eye(side= "right") +
  theme_light() +
  scale_fill_manual(name= "Condition",labels= c("Mound", "No mound"),values = c("#E69F00", "#999999"))+
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="right")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  coord_flip() + # This switch X and Y axis and allows to get the horizontal version
    xlab("") 
pHlog1_D2_3

fitGLMM2_burrow <- brm(conductivitylog ~ + B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM2_burrow)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: conductivitylog ~ +B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 43) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     0.88      0.27     0.52     1.54 1.00     6560    10251
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                          0.78      0.55    -0.34     1.88 1.00
## B.or.NBNB                         -0.18      0.15    -0.48     0.12 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                     0.20      0.77    -1.35     1.74 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous              -0.88      0.79    -2.44     0.68 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                -1.69      0.78    -3.28    -0.11 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          -0.11      0.21    -0.53     0.31 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous     0.06      0.21    -0.36     0.48 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain       0.10      0.21    -0.31     0.51 1.00
##                                Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                          9746    10023
## B.or.NBNB                         13824    12922
## Grass.typeArid                    10523    10016
## Grass.typeCalcareous              10462    10678
## Grass.typeMountain                10070     9784
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          15716    13873
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous    15584    14544
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain      15692    15154
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.21      0.03     0.16     0.28 1.00    11116    12520
## 
## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
condlog1_D2<-fitGLMM2_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "conductivity scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
condlog1_D2

condlog1_D2_3<-fitGLMM2_burrow%>%

  stat_eye(side= "right") +
  theme_light() +

  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +

  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="right")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(

##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: Calog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 43) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects:

fitGLMM4_burrow <- brm(Klog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)

fitGLMM5_burrow <- brm(Mglog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM5_burrow)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: Mglog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 43) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     1.15      0.36     0.65     2.03 1.00     6087    10105
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                          0.20      0.76    -1.30     1.71 1.00
## B.or.NBNB                         -0.05      0.38    -0.80     0.71 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                    -0.22      1.08    -2.37     1.95 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous              -0.07      1.09    -2.23     2.14 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                 0.17      1.08    -1.93     2.37 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          -0.85      0.54    -1.92     0.22 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous    -0.21      0.53    -1.25     0.83 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain       0.08      0.53    -0.95     1.11 1.00
##                                Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                          9596    10683
## B.or.NBNB                         13297    13098
## Grass.typeArid                    10590    10301
## Grass.typeCalcareous               9817    10678
## Grass.typeMountain                 9956    10780
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          14756    14504
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous    15099    14599
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain      14471    14009
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.54      0.08     0.41     0.72 1.00     9781    10718

## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
Mglog1_D2<-fitGLMM5_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "Mg scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
Mglog1_D2

fitGLMM7_burrow <- brm(P.TUDlog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM7_burrow)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: P.TUDlog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 43) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     0.80      0.25     0.46     1.42 1.00     6519     9902
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                          1.24      0.51     0.24     2.28 1.00
## B.or.NBNB                          0.25      0.22    -0.18     0.69 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                    -1.42      0.72    -2.87    -0.01 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous              -1.39      0.72    -2.82     0.03 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                -1.09      0.73    -2.54     0.37 1.00

## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain      -0.59      0.30    -1.19     0.02 1.00
##                                Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                         10042     9470
## B.or.NBNB                         12144    12875
## Grass.typeArid                    10372    11180
## Grass.typeCalcareous              10662    11509
## Grass.typeMountain                10170    11261
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          13803    13534
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous    13795    13811
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain      13768    13732
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.31      0.05     0.24     0.42 1.00    10709    11945

## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
Plog1_D2<-fitGLMM7_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "P scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
Plog1_D2

Corglog_W_2<-fitGLMM8_burrow_W_2%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Grass.type, y = .value, fill=B.or.NB)) + labs( y = "Organic Carbon" )+
  stat_eye(side= "right") +
  theme_light() +
  scale_fill_manual(name= "Condition",labels= c("Mound", "No mound"),values = c("#52854C", "#999999"))+
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank()) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="right")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  coord_flip() + # This switch X and Y axis and allows to get the horizontal version
    xlab("")
